name: Pasteurized Fresh Milk (1L)
spoilage_indicators: Sour odor, curdling, carton bloating; discard immediately if held above 4 C for over 2 hours.
dhaka_handling_rule: Maintain unbroken 2-4 C cold chain during Satmasjid Road and Gulshan transit; trigger 20-40% markdown at <= 48h remaining.

name: Plain Yogurt / Doi (500g)
spoilage_indicators: Excess whey separation, mold spots on rim, sharp acidic smell.
dhaka_handling_rule: Rotate strictly by FEFO; prioritize front-facing chiller placement at Agora Gulshan 2 and Unimart Banani.

name: Fresh Paneer Block
spoilage_indicators: Slimy surface film, yellowing edges, rancid odor.
dhaka_handling_rule: High unit value SKU; rebalance between Gulshan and Dhanmondi branches before 36h expiry mark.

name: Vine-Ripened Tomatoes
spoilage_indicators: Soft bruised skin, leaking juice, dark stem mold.
dhaka_handling_rule: During >30 C Dhaka afternoons, shift to 12 C cool zone and apply 25-30% markdown at 36h remaining.

name: Leafy Spinach (Palong Shak)
spoilage_indicators: Wilting leaves, darkened slimy stems, ammonia-like odor.
dhaka_handling_rule: Ultra-short 72h window; never over-dispatch on rainy days when Dhaka store footfall drops 15-20%.

name: Green Chili (Kacha Morich)
spoilage_indicators: Shrinking pods, moisture condensation causing black spots.
dhaka_handling_rule: Keep dry inside ventilated crates to prevent monsoon condensation rot.

name: Fresh Cucumber (Shosha)
spoilage_indicators: Pitting below 7 C (chilling injury), soft watery ends, yellowing skin.
dhaka_handling_rule: Avoid sub-7 C deep chillers; store away from ethylene-emitting bananas and tomatoes.

name: Fresh Coriander (Dhone Pata)
dhaka_handling_rule: Dispatch in smaller daily FEFO waves; auto-flag 40% markdown under 24h remaining.

name: Sagor Bananas (Green-Ripe)
spoilage_indicators: Stage 5-6 heavy brown spotting, split peel, fermented aroma.
dhaka_handling_rule: Scan via Vision Ripeness Agent daily; trigger 30% markdown automatically when ripeness reaches Stage 5.

name: Himsagar Mangoes
spoilage_indicators: Dark sunken sap spots, overly soft flesh near stem, sour fermentation.
dhaka_handling_rule: High weekend velocity in Gulshan and Banani; rebalance surplus from Uttara before 40h threshold.

name: Red Papaya (Paka Pepe)
spoilage_indicators: Water-soaked patches, mold near blossom end, mushy texture.
dhaka_handling_rule: Trigger 25% dynamic markdown as soon as skin shifts >85% amber-orange.

name: Thai Guava (Peyara)
dhaka_handling_rule: Keep refrigerated at 8-10 C; cross-dock excess crates to high-traffic Shwapno Dhanmondi.

name: Chilled Broiler Chicken (Dressed)
spoilage_indicators: Grayish discoloration, sticky tacky surface, sulfurous odor.
dhaka_handling_rule: Strict 48h USDA refrigerated limit and highest CO2e impact (4.5 kg/kg); enforce early 30% markdown at 24h left.

name: Sonali Chicken Cuts (Chilled)
spoilage_indicators: Off-odor upon opening, slimy sheen, broken vacuum seal.
dhaka_handling_rule: Dispatch strictly in insulated reefer vans; zero tolerance for >4 C transit excursion.

name: Fresh Rohu Fish Steaks (Chilled)
spoilage_indicators: Cloudy eyes, dull gills, strong ammonia odor, soft flesh that does not spring back.
dhaka_handling_rule: 48h USDA fresh-fish ceiling; morning-only delivery wave with automatic 35% evening markdown if unsold.

name: Farm Brown Eggs (30-Pack Tray)
spoilage_indicators: Cracked shells, watery egg whites, sulfurous smell.
dhaka_handling_rule: Store away from pungent produce; long shelf-life buffer stabilizes weekend Dhaka replenishment.
